'''2016 Worlds Day 2 Tony Garcia LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tony Garcia]] at [[2016 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Tony Garcia]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 World Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
